extra.circuit_description: ECM, EHCU (electric hydraulic control unit), TCM (transmission control module), DRM (data recording module) எல்லாம் CAN communication bus வழியா control/diagnostic information exchange பண்ணிக்கும். ECM ஒவ்வொரு module-இல் இருந்தும் constant message flow expect பண்ணி CAN operational status monitor பண்ணும்.
extra.sets_when: ECM CAN Bus OFF status detect பண்ணா set ஆகும்.

circuit_description: The ECM, EHCU (electric hydraulic control unit), TCM (transmission control module) and DRM (data recording module) all exchange control/diagnostic information over the CAN communication bus. The ECM expects a constant message flow from every module and monitors the CAN operational status.

ECM, EHCU (electric hydraulic control unit), TCM (transmission control module) සහ DRM (data recording module) සියල්ලම CAN සන්නිවේදන බස් එක හරහා පාලන/රෝග විනිශ්චය තොරතුරු හුවමාරු කරගනී. ECM එක සෑම මොඩියුලයකින්ම නොකඩවා පණිවිඩ ගලා ඒම අපේක්ෂා කරමින් CAN ක්‍රියාකාරී තත්ත්වය නිරීක්ෂණය කරයි.
running_condition: Battery voltage must be above 20 volts
බැටරි වෝල්ටීයතාව වෝල්ට් 20 ට වැඩි විය යුතුය
sets_when: Sets when the ECM detects a CAN Bus OFF status.
ECM එක CAN Bus OFF තත්ත්වයක් හඳුනාගත් විට සකස් වේ.
ecm_action: MIL illuminates — on the 2nd consecutive driving cycle
MIL ආලෝකය දැල්වේ — අඛණ්ඩ 2වන ධාවන චක්‍රයේදී
Exhaust brake indicator lamp blinks
Exhaust brake දර්ශක ලාම්පුව ගැස්සේ
Fuel injection quantity is limited
ඉන්ධන එන්නත් ප්‍රමාණය සීමා වේ
Exhaust brake control is inhibited
Exhaust brake පාලනය වළක්වනු ලැබේ
diagnostic_aid: The parallel resistance of the 120 Ω resistors in the ECM and the IP cluster should be 60 Ω.
ECM සහ IP cluster හි ඇති 120 Ω ප්‍රතිරෝධක දෙකේ සමාන්තර ප්‍රතිරෝධය 60 Ω විය යුතුය.

symptoms.si: SVS ලාම්පුව ON (Euro 4 පිරිවිතර) හෝ MIL ON (Euro 4 හැර)

symptoms.ta: Exhaust brake indicator lamp diagnostic run/fail time-ல் blink ஆகும்
symptoms.en: Exhaust brake indicator lamp blinks during the diagnostic run/fail time
symptoms.si: රෝග විනිශ්චය ධාවන/අසාර්ථක කාලයේදී Exhaust brake දර්ශක ලාම්පුව ගැස්සේ

symptoms.ta: Exhaust brake control ECM-ஆல் inhibit ஆகும் (exhaust brake வேலை செய்யாது)
symptoms.en: ECM inhibits exhaust brake control (exhaust brake will not work)
symptoms.si: ECM එක Exhaust brake පාලනය වළක්වයි (Exhaust brake ක්‍රියා නොකරයි)

symptoms.ta: TCM/transmission communication இல்லாததால் shift-related symptoms உடன் சேர்ந்தும் வரலாம்
symptoms.en: May also appear together with shift-related symptoms because there is no TCM/transmission communication
symptoms.si: TCM/ට්‍රාන්ස්මිෂන් සන්නිවේදනය නොමැති නිසා ගියර් මාරු වීමේ ගැටලු සමඟද පැමිණිය හැක

causes.ta: TCM-க்கும் ECM-க்கும் இடையே CAN Low/High circuit-ல் open circuit அல்லது high resistance
causes.en: Open circuit or high resistance in the CAN Low/High circuit between the TCM and ECM
causes.si: TCM සහ ECM අතර CAN Low/High පරිපථයේ විවෘත පරිපථයක් හෝ ඉහළ ප්‍රතිරෝධයක්

causes.en: Poor/corroded connection at TCM connector B112 (pins 12/13)
causes.si: TCM සම්බන්ධක B112 (pin 12/13) හි දුර්වල/විඛාදනය වූ සම්බන්ධතාව

steps.ta: STEP 1: Diagnostic System Check - Engine Controls perform பண்ணீங்களா? இல்லைனா முதலில் அதை பண்ணுங்க
steps.en: STEP 1: Have you performed the Diagnostic System Check – Engine Controls? If not, do that first.
steps.si: පියවර 1: Diagnostic System Check – Engine Controls සිදු කළාද? නැතිනම් මුලින්ම ඒක කරන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 2: Scan tool install பண்ணுங்க → ignition 30 நொடி OFF → engine start பண்ணுங்க → scan tool-ல் DTC info monitor பண்ணுங்க. DTC U0073 அல்லது U0110 வேற set ஆகி இருக்கானு பாருங்க — இருந்தா அந்த applicable DTC-க்கே போங்க
steps.en: STEP 2: Install the scan tool → ignition OFF for 30 seconds → start the engine → monitor the DTC info on the scan tool. Check whether DTC U0073 or U0110 is also set — if so, go to that applicable DTC first.
steps.si: පියවර 2: ස්කෑන් ටූල් එක සවි කරන්න → ඉග්නිෂන් තත්පර 30ක් OFF → එන්ජිම පණ ගන්වන්න → ස්කෑන් ටූල් එකේ DTC තොරතුරු නිරීක්ෂණය කරන්න. DTC U0073 හෝ U0110 ද සකස් වී ඇත්දැයි බලන්න — එසේ නම් මුලින්ම අදාළ DTC වෙත යන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 3: Scan tool-ஐ transmission data table வழியா TCM-உடன் communicate பண்ண try பண்ணுங்க. Communicate ஆகுதா? இல்லைனா Section 5A Transmission Control System-ல் Diagnostic System Check - Transmission Controls பாருங்க
steps.en: STEP 3: Try to communicate with the TCM through the transmission data table on the scan tool. Does it communicate? If not, see Diagnostic System Check – Transmission Controls in Section 5A Transmission Control System.
steps.si: පියවර 3: ස්කෑන් ටූල් එකේ transmission data table හරහා TCM සමඟ සන්නිවේදනය කිරීමට උත්සාහ කරන්න. සන්නිවේදනය වේද? නැතිනම් Section 5A Transmission Control System හි Diagnostic System Check – Transmission Controls බලන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 4: Ignition OFF → TCM B112 harness connector disconnect பண்ணுங்க → ignition ON (engine OFF) → DMM வெச்சு CAN Low circuit (B112 pin 13) மற்றும் CAN High circuit (B112 pin 12) இரண்டையும் தனித்தனியா known good ground-உடன் measure பண்ணுங்க — இரண்டு readings-உம் 1.5 to 3.5 volts range-ல் இருக்கணும்
steps.en: STEP 4: Ignition OFF → disconnect the TCM B112 harness connector → ignition ON (engine OFF) → with a DMM, measure the CAN Low circuit (B112 pin 13) and the CAN High circuit (B112 pin 12) separately against a known good ground — both readings should be within 1.5 to 3.5 volts.
steps.si: පියවර 4: ඉග්නිෂන් OFF → TCM B112 හාර්නස් සම්බන්ධකය ගලවන්න → ඉග්නිෂන් ON (එන්ජිම OFF) → DMM එකකින් CAN Low පරිපථය (B112 pin 13) සහ CAN High පරිපථය (B112 pin 12) වෙන වෙනම හොඳ භූගතයට සාපේක්ෂව මනින්න — කියවීම් දෙකම වෝල්ට් 1.5 – 3.5 පරාසයේ විය යුතුය.

steps.ta: STEP 5: Step 4-ல் spec range-க்கு வெளிய இருந்த CAN circuit-ல் (Low/High) TCM (pins 12/13 of B112)-க்கும் CAN joint connectors-க்கும் இடையே open circuit/high resistance repair பண்ணுங்க
steps.en: STEP 5: For the CAN circuit (Low/High) that was out of the Step 4 spec range, repair the open circuit/high resistance between the TCM (pins 12/13 of B112) and the CAN joint connectors.
steps.si: පියවර 5: පියවර 4 හි පිරිවිතර පරාසයෙන් පිටත වූ CAN පරිපථයේ (Low/High) TCM (B112 pin 12/13) සහ CAN joint සම්බන්ධක අතර විවෘත පරිපථය/ඉහළ ප්‍රතිරෝධය අලුත්වැඩියා කරන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 6: TCM B112 connector pins 12 & 13-ல் intermittent fault, poor connection, corrosion இருக்கானு inspect பண்ணி repair பண்ணுங்க
steps.en: STEP 6: Inspect TCM connector B112 pins 12 & 13 for intermittent faults, poor connection and corrosion, and repair.
steps.si: පියවර 6: TCM සම්බන්ධක B112 pin 12 සහ 13 හි විටින් විට දෝෂ, දුර්වල සම්බන්ධතා සහ විඛාදනය පරීක්ෂා කර අලුත්වැඩියා කරන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 7: மேல Steps-ல் fault fix ஆகலைனா — Replacement TCM program/learn பண்ண வேண்டியது அவசியம் — TCM replace பண்ணுங்க (Section 5A Transmission Control System)
steps.en: STEP 7: If the fault is not fixed by the steps above — a replacement TCM must be programmed/learned — replace the TCM (Section 5A Transmission Control System).
steps.si: පියවර 7: ඉහත පියවරවලින් දෝෂය නිවැරදි නොවුණහොත් — ආදේශක TCM එක program/learn කළ යුතුය — TCM මාරු කරන්න (Section 5A Transmission Control System).

steps.ta: STEP 8: எல்லா disconnected connectors-ஐயும் reconnect பண்ணுங்க → DTCs scan tool-ல் clear பண்ணுங்க → ignition 30 நொடி OFF → engine start பண்ணுங்க → Freeze Frame/Failure Record-ல் இருந்த conditions-லயே vehicle operate பண்ணி DTC திரும்ப fail ஆகுதான்னு பாருங்க
steps.en: STEP 8: Reconnect all disconnected connectors → clear the DTCs on the scan tool → ignition OFF for 30 seconds → start the engine → operate the vehicle under the same conditions as the Freeze Frame/Failure Record and see whether the DTC fails again.
steps.si: පියවර 8: ගලවා ඇති සියලු සම්බන්ධක නැවත සම්බන්ධ කරන්න → ස්කෑන් ටූල් එකෙන් DTC මකන්න → ඉග්නිෂන් තත්පර 30ක් OFF → එන්ජිම පණ ගන්වන්න → Freeze Frame/Failure Record හි තිබූ තත්ත්වයන්ටම වාහනය ධාවනය කර DTC නැවත අසාර්ථක වේදැයි බලන්න.

repair.ta: Root cause TCM CAN wiring/connector fault-ஆ இருந்தா repair பண்ணுங்க; TCM faulty-ஆ இருந்தா replace பண்ணி program/learn பண்ணுங்க. Code clear பண்ணி road test பண்ணி confirm பண்ணுங்க.
repair.en: If the root cause is a TCM CAN wiring/connector fault, repair it; if the TCM is faulty, replace it and program/learn. Clear the code and confirm with a road test.
repair.si: මූලික හේතුව TCM CAN රැහැන්/සම්බන්ධක දෝෂයක් නම් අලුත්වැඩියා කරන්න; TCM දෝෂ සහිත නම් මාරු කර program/learn කරන්න. කේතය මකා මාර්ග පරීක්ෂණයකින් තහවුරු කරන්න.

source: Isuzu 4JJ1 Service Manual — Section 1A-296/297, Engine Control System

extra.circuit_description: ECM மற்றும் TCM இரண்டும் control/diagnostic information-ஐ CAN (Controller Area Network) communication bus வழியா exchange பண்ணிக்கும். ஒவ்வொரு module-இல் இருந்தும் constant flow-ல் message வரும்னு ECM expect பண்ணி CAN operational status monitor பண்ணும். TCM-இல் இருந்து வர வேண்டிய expected message ECM-க்கு receive ஆகலைனா, இந்த DTC set ஆகும்.
running_condition: DTC U0073 (CAN Bus Off) set ஆகி இருக்கக்கூடாது
extra.sets_when: TCM-இல் இருந்து CAN Bus messages ECM-க்கு receive ஆகலைனு ECM detect பண்ணா U0101 set ஆகும்
ecm_action: SVS lamp illuminate ஆகும் — Type C (Euro 4 specification)
MIL illuminate ஆகும் — Type A (Except Euro 4 specification)
Exhaust brake indicator lamp blink ஆகும்
ECM exhaust brake control-ஐ inhibit பண்ணும்
extra.diagnostic_aid: Intermittent fault சந்தேகப்பட்டா, Intermittent Conditions section பாருங்க.
extra.clearing_condition: Type C DTC clearing definitions படி (Euro 4 spec — SVS Lamp/DTC clearing), அல்லது Type A DTC clearing definitions படி (Except Euro 4 — MIL/DTC clearing).
extra.location: Transmission Control Module (TCM) — CAN Low/High circuit (Connector B112, pins 12 & 13)
extra.wiring:
Connector: B112 (TCM)
Pin 12: CAN High circuit
Pin 13: CAN Low circuit
Spec: 1.5 – 3.5 V (both circuits, key ON engine OFF, TCM disconnected, measured to known good ground)

Connector End View Reference: Engine Controls Connector End Views / ECM Connector End Views
Reference: Isuzu 4JJ1 Service Manual Section 1A-296/297

circuit_description: The ECM and TCM exchange control/diagnostic information over the CAN (Controller Area Network) communication bus. The ECM expects a constant flow of messages from each module and monitors the CAN operational status. If the expected message from the TCM is not received by the ECM, this DTC is set.

ECM සහ TCM දෙකම CAN (Controller Area Network) සන්නිවේදන බස් එක හරහා පාලන/රෝග විනිශ්චය තොරතුරු හුවමාරු කරගනී. ECM එක සෑම මොඩියුලයකින්ම නොකඩවා පණිවිඩ ලැබීම අපේක්ෂා කරමින් CAN ක්‍රියාකාරී තත්ත්වය නිරීක්ෂණය කරයි. TCM එකෙන් ලැබිය යුතු අපේක්ෂිත පණිවිඩය ECM එකට නොලැබුණහොත් මෙම DTC සකස් වේ.
running_condition: DTC U0073 (CAN Bus Off) must not be set
DTC U0073 (CAN Bus Off) සකස් වී නොතිබිය යුතුය
Battery voltage must be above 20 volts
බැටරි වෝල්ටීයතාව වෝල්ට් 20 ට වැඩි විය යුතුය
sets_when: U0101 sets when the ECM detects that CAN bus messages from the TCM are not being received.
TCM එකෙන් CAN bus පණිවිඩ ECM එකට නොලැබෙන බව ECM එක හඳුනාගත් විට U0101 සකස් වේ.
ecm_action: SVS lamp illuminates — Type C (Euro 4 specification)
SVS ලාම්පුව දැල්වේ — Type C (Euro 4 පිරිවිතර)
MIL illuminates — Type A (except Euro 4 specification)
MIL දැල්වේ — Type A (Euro 4 හැර)
Exhaust brake indicator lamp blinks
Exhaust brake දර්ශක ලාම්පුව ගැස්සේ
ECM inhibits exhaust brake control
ECM එක Exhaust brake පාලනය වළක්වයි
clearing_condition: Per the Type C DTC clearing definition (Euro 4 spec — SVS lamp/DTC clearing), or the Type A DTC clearing definition (except Euro 4 — MIL/DTC clearing).
Type C DTC මකා දැමීමේ නිර්වචනයට අනුව (Euro 4 — SVS ලාම්පුව/DTC මකා දැමීම), හෝ Type A DTC මකා දැමීමේ නිර්වචනයට අනුව (Euro 4 හැර — MIL/DTC මකා දැමීම).
diagnostic_aid: If you suspect an intermittent fault, see the Intermittent Conditions section.
විටින් විට ඇතිවන දෝෂයක් ගැන සැක නම් Intermittent Conditions කොටස බලන්න.

Yaw rate sensor module (airbag sensor assembly) power/ground fault

steps.ta: CAN bus wiring/connector inspect பண்ணுங்க
Sensor module power/ground voltage check பண்ணுங்க
Scan tool-ல் communication status monitor பண்ணுங்க

repair.ta: CAN wiring fault confirம் ஆனா repair பண்ணுங்க. Sensor module fault confirம் ஆனா replace பண்ணி (⚠ replace பண்ணின பிறகு zero-point calibration compulsory) confirம் பண்ணுங்க. இந்த DTC fix ஆனதுக்கு பிறகு C1336-ஐ மறுபடியும் check பண்ணுங்க.

title.si: Immobilizer පාලන ඒකකය (ICU) සමඟ CAN සන්නිවේදනය අහිමි වීම

symptoms.si: පණ නොගැන්වීම (immobilizer එක එන්ජිම පණ ගැන්වීම වළක්වයි)

symptoms.ta: SVS lamp ON (Euro 4 spec) அல்லது MIL ON (Except Euro 4 spec)
symptoms.en: SVS lamp ON (Euro 4 spec) or MIL ON (except Euro 4 spec)
symptoms.si: SVS ලාම්පුව ON (Euro 4 පිරිවිතර) හෝ MIL ON (Euro 4 හැර)

symptoms.ta: Scan tool-ல் ECM, ICU-உடன் communicate பண்ண முடியலைனு காட்டும்
symptoms.en: Scan tool shows that the ECM cannot communicate with the ICU
symptoms.si: ECM එකට ICU සමඟ සන්නිවේදනය කළ නොහැකි බව ස්කෑන් ටූල් එක පෙන්වයි

symptoms.ta: Cranking normal-ஆ இருந்தாலும், engine start ஆகிற உடனேயே stall ஆகும் அல்லது cranking-ஏ block ஆகும்
symptoms.en: Even if cranking is normal, the engine stalls right after starting, or cranking itself is blocked
symptoms.si: ක්‍රෑන්කින් සාමාන්‍ය වුවත්, පණ ගත් වහාම එන්ජිම නැවතීම හෝ ක්‍රෑන්කින්ම වැළකීම

causes.ta: ECM-க்கும் ICU-க்கும் இடையே CAN communication fault
causes.en: CAN communication fault between the ECM and ICU
causes.si: ECM සහ ICU අතර CAN සන්නිවේදන දෝෂය

causes.ta: Electromagnetic interference (EMI) intermittent condition-ஐ affect பண்ணலாம்
causes.en: Electromagnetic interference (EMI) can affect the intermittent condition
causes.si: විද්‍යුත් චුම්භක බාධා (EMI) විටින් විට ඇතිවන තත්ත්වයට බලපෑ හැක

causes.ta: ICU harness connector (B-109) அல்லது DLC (B-58) பகுதியில் loose/corroded connection
causes.en: Loose/corroded connection at the ICU harness connector (B-109) or the DLC (B-58) area
causes.si: ICU හාර්නස් සම්බන්ධකය (B-109) හෝ DLC (B-58) ප්‍රදේශයේ ලිහිල්/විඛාදනය වූ සම්බන්ධතාව

causes.ta: CAN High/Low circuit-ல் intermittent open/short (ground அல்லது voltage-க்கு)
causes.en: Intermittent open/short (to ground or voltage) in the CAN High/Low circuit
causes.si: CAN High/Low පරිපථයේ විටින් විට විවෘත/short (භූගතයට හෝ වෝල්ටීයතාවයට) වීම

causes.ta: Immobilizer system-ல் வேற DTC (P0633, P161B) set ஆகி இருக்கலாம்
causes.en: Another DTC (P0633, P161B) may be set in the immobilizer system
causes.si: Immobilizer පද්ධතියේ වෙනත් DTC (P0633, P161B) සකස් වී තිබිය හැක

steps.ta: STEP 1: Diagnostic System Check - Engine Controls perform பண்ணீங்களா? இல்லைனா முதலில் அதை பண்ணுங்க
steps.en: STEP 1: Have you performed the Diagnostic System Check – Engine Controls? If not, do that first.
steps.si: පියවර 1: Diagnostic System Check – Engine Controls සිදු කළාද? නැතිනම් මුලින්ම ඒක කරන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 2: Scan tool-ஐ Immobilizer Data table வழியா Immobilizer Control Unit (ICU)-உடன் communicate பண்ண try பண்ணுங்க. Communicate ஆகுதா? இல்லைனா Section 9I Security and Lock-ல் Diagnostic System Check - Immobilizer Controls பாருங்க
steps.en: STEP 2: Try to communicate with the Immobilizer Control Unit (ICU) through the Immobilizer Data table on the scan tool. Does it communicate? If not, see Diagnostic System Check – Immobilizer Controls in Section 9I Security and Lock.
steps.si: පියවර 2: ස්කෑන් ටූල් එකේ Immobilizer Data table හරහා Immobilizer Control Unit (ICU) සමඟ සන්නිවේදනය කිරීමට උත්සාහ කරන්න. සන්නිවේදනය වේද? නැතිනම් Section 9I Security and Lock හි Diagnostic System Check – Immobilizer Controls බලන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 3: Immobilizer DTC information scan tool-ல் monitor பண்ணுங்க — இந்த ignition cycle-ல் immobilizer DTCs fail ஆகுதா பாருங்க. Fail ஆனா Immobilizer section-ல் applicable DTC-க்கே போங்க
steps.en: STEP 3: Monitor the immobilizer DTC information on the scan tool — see whether any immobilizer DTCs fail in this ignition cycle. If they do, go to the applicable DTC in the Immobilizer section.
steps.si: පියවර 3: ස්කෑන් ටූල් එකේ immobilizer DTC තොරතුරු නිරීක්ෂණය කරන්න — මෙම ඉග්නිෂන් චක්‍රයේදී immobilizer DTC අසාර්ථක වේදැයි බලන්න. අසාර්ථක වුවහොත් Immobilizer කොටසේ අදාළ DTC වෙත යන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 4: மேல Steps-ல் root cause கிடைக்கலைனா — Replacement ECM program/learn பண்ண வேண்டியது அவசியம் — ECM replace பண்ணுங்க (ECM Replacement procedure)
steps.en: STEP 4: If no root cause is found in the steps above — a replacement ECM must be programmed/learned — replace the ECM (ECM Replacement procedure).
steps.si: පියවර 4: ඉහත පියවරවලින් මූලික හේතුවක් හමු නොවුණහොත් — ආදේශක ECM එක program/learn කළ යුතුය — ECM මාරු කරන්න (ECM Replacement ක්‍රියාපටිපාටිය).

steps.ta: STEP 5: DTCs scan tool-ல் clear பண்ணுங்க → ignition 30 நொடி OFF → ignition ON (engine OFF) → DTC திரும்ப fail ஆகுதான்னு பாருங்க
steps.en: STEP 5: Clear the DTCs on the scan tool → ignition OFF for 30 seconds → ignition ON (engine OFF) → see whether the DTC fails again.
steps.si: පියවර 5: ස්කෑන් ටූල් එකෙන් DTC මකන්න → ඉග්නිෂන් තත්පර 30ක් OFF → ඉග්නිෂන් ON (එන්ජිම OFF) → DTC නැවත අසාර්ථක වේදැයි බලන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 6: Scan tool-ல் DTC information observe பண்ணுங்க — வேற diagnose பண்ணாத DTCs இருக்கா பாருங்க
steps.en: STEP 6: Observe the DTC information on the scan tool — check whether any other undiagnosed DTCs are present.
steps.si: පියවර 6: ස්කෑන් ටූල් එකේ DTC තොරතුරු නිරීක්ෂණය කරන්න — රෝග විනිශ්චය නොකළ වෙනත් DTC තිබේදැයි බලන්න.

repair.ta: Immobilizer DTC வேற ஏதாவது இருந்தா அதை முதலில் diagnose பண்ணுங்க. ECM power/ground/relay/fuse சரியா இருக்கானு confirm பண்ணுங்க. CAN bus wiring-ல் short/open இருந்தா repair பண்ணுங்க. ECM fault confirm ஆனா — replace பண்ணி program/learn பண்ணுங்க. Code clear பண்ணி confirm பண்ணுங்க.
repair.en: If any other immobilizer DTC is present, diagnose it first. Confirm that ECM power/ground/relay/fuse are good. If the CAN bus wiring has a short/open, repair it. If an ECM fault is confirmed — replace it and program/learn. Clear the code and confirm.
repair.si: වෙනත් immobilizer DTC තිබේ නම් මුලින්ම එය රෝග විනිශ්චය කරන්න. ECM බලය/භූගතය/relay/fuse හරිදැයි තහවුරු කරන්න. CAN bus රැහැන්වල short/විවෘත තිබේ නම් අලුත්වැඩියා කරන්න. ECM දෝෂයක් තහවුරු වුවහොත් — මාරු කර program/learn කරන්න. කේතය මකා තහවුරු කරන්න.

source: Isuzu 4JJ1 Service Manual — Section 1A-298, Engine Control System

extra.circuit_description: Immobilizer function execute பண்ண ECM, Immobilizer Control Unit (ICU)-உடன் communicate பண்ணும். ECM ஒரு request signal ICU-க்கு அனுப்பும், ICU-இல் இருந்து response signal receive பண்ணும். இந்த இரண்டு communication signals-உம் CAN (Controller Area Network) communication bus வழியாதான் நடக்கும். ICU-இல் இருந்து response signal ECM-க்கு detect ஆகலைனா, இந்த DTC set ஆகும். ⚠ Immobilizer system active-ஆ இருந்து இந்த communication loss இருந்தா, ECM fuel injection-ஐ disable பண்ணிடும் — engine crank ஆகும், ஆனா start ஆகிற உடனேயே stall ஆகிடும் (அல்லது Starter Cut Relay energize ஆகி cranking-ஏ disable ஆகலாம்).
extra.sets_when: ICU-இல் இருந்து immobilizer response signal ECM-க்கு receive ஆகலைனா U0167 set ஆகும்
ecm_action: SVS lamp illuminate ஆகும் — Type C (Euro 4 specification)
MIL illuminate ஆகும் — Type A (Except Euro 4 specification)
extra.diagnostic_aid: Intermittent fault சந்தேகப்பட்டா, Intermittent Conditions section பாருங்க. Electromagnetic interference (EMI) intermittent condition-ஐ affect பண்ணலாம். ICU-உடன் ஏதாவது communication fault இருந்தாலும் இந்த DTC set ஆகலாம். Communication totally lost-ஆ இருந்தா, முதலில் ECM power/ground rule-out பண்ணுங்க: battery voltage 18–32V, ECM ground (J13/J14 connectors, pins 22/24/62/68/81), ECM main relay (X18), ECM fuses (30A slow blow, main 10A) — இவை சரியில்லைனா CAN communication-ஏ ஏற்படாது.
extra.clearing_condition: Type C DTC clearing definitions படி (Euro 4 spec — SVS Lamp/DTC clearing), அல்லது Type A DTC clearing definitions படி (Except Euro 4 — MIL/DTC clearing).
extra.location: Immobilizer Control Unit (ICU) ↔ ECM CAN Communication — ICU harness connector B-109, பொதுவா steering column/ignition switch பகுதியில் mount ஆகி இருக்கும்.
extra.wiring:
ICU-உடன் ECM CAN bus வழியா communicate பண்ணும் — dedicated pin-out இந்த DTC-க்கு தனியா manual-ல் குறிப்பிடல (shared CAN bus circuit).

CAN Bus Circuit:
CAN High: DLC Pin 6 — ECM Pin 58 (J14) — ICU Pin 6 — CAN resistor Pin 1
CAN Low: DLC Pin 14 — ECM Pin 78 (J14) — ICU Pin 5 — CAN resistor Pin 2
Resistance spec (DLC Pin 6 & 14 இடையே, ignition OFF): 50–70Ω

ECM Power/Ground:
Battery voltage: 18–32V (24V system)
ECM ground: J13, J14 — Pins 22, 24, 62, 68, 81
ECM main relay: X18
Fuses: ECM (30A) slow blow, ECM main (10A), ECM (10A)

Connector End View Reference: Engine Controls Connector End Views / ECM Connector End Views
Reference: Isuzu 4JJ1 Service Manual Section 1A-298

liveData.note: No என்றால் ECM-ல் immobilizer program ஆகல
ICU-இல் இருந்து response signal வந்திருக்கா-ன்னு காட்டும்
Active-ஆ இருந்தா wrong code attempt-ஆல் wait period நடக்குது

circuit_description: To carry out the immobilizer function, the ECM communicates with the Immobilizer Control Unit (ICU). The ECM sends a request signal to the ICU and receives a response signal from it. Both communication signals travel over the CAN (Controller Area Network) communication bus. If the response signal from the ICU is not detected by the ECM, this DTC is set. ⚠ If this communication loss occurs while the immobilizer system is active, the ECM disables fuel injection — the engine will crank but stall right after starting (or the Starter Cut Relay may energize and disable cranking altogether).

Immobilizer ක්‍රියාව සිදු කිරීමට ECM එක Immobilizer Control Unit (ICU) සමඟ සන්නිවේදනය කරයි. ECM එක ICU වෙත ඉල්ලීම් සංඥාවක් යවා ICU එකෙන් ප්‍රතිචාර සංඥාවක් ලබාගනී. මෙම සංඥා දෙකම CAN (Controller Area Network) සන්නිවේදන බස් එක හරහාම සිදු වේ. ICU එකෙන් ප්‍රතිචාර සංඥාව ECM එකට හඳුනාගත නොහැකි වුවහොත් මෙම DTC සකස් වේ. ⚠ Immobilizer පද්ධතිය ක්‍රියාත්මක අවස්ථාවේ මෙම සන්නිවේදන අහිමි වීම සිදුවුවහොත්, ECM එක ඉන්ධන එන්නත් කිරීම අක්‍රිය කරයි — එන්ජිම කරකැවෙනු ඇති නමුත් පණ ගත් වහාම නැවතේ (නැතහොත් Starter Cut Relay එක ක්‍රියාත්මක වී ක්‍රෑන්කින්ම අක්‍රිය විය හැක).
ecm_action: SVS lamp illuminates — Type C (Euro 4 specification)
SVS ලාම්පුව දැල්වේ — Type C (Euro 4 පිරිවිතර)
MIL illuminates — Type A (except Euro 4 specification)
MIL දැල්වේ — Type A (Euro 4 හැර)
clearing_condition: Per the Type C DTC clearing definition (Euro 4 spec — SVS lamp/DTC clearing), or the Type A DTC clearing definition (except Euro 4 — MIL/DTC clearing).
Type C DTC මකා දැමීමේ නිර්වචනයට අනුව (Euro 4 — SVS ලාම්පුව/DTC මකා දැමීම), හෝ Type A DTC මකා දැමීමේ නිර්වචනයට අනුව (Euro 4 හැර — MIL/DTC මකා දැමීම).
diagnostic_aid: If you suspect an intermittent fault, see the Intermittent Conditions section. Electromagnetic interference (EMI) can affect the intermittent condition. This DTC can also set if there is any communication fault with the ICU. If communication is completely lost, first rule out ECM power/ground: battery voltage 18–32 V, ECM ground (connectors J13/J14, pins 22/24/62/68/81), ECM main relay (X18), ECM fuses (30 A slow blow, main 10 A) — if these are not OK, CAN communication will not happen at all.

විටින් විට ඇතිවන දෝෂයක් ගැන සැක නම් Intermittent Conditions කොටස බලන්න. විද්‍යුත් චුම්භක බාධා (EMI) විටින් විට ඇතිවන තත්ත්වයට බලපෑ හැක. ICU සමඟ යම් සන්නිවේදන දෝෂයක් තිබුණත් මෙම DTC සකස් විය හැක. සන්නිවේදනය සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම අහිමි නම්, මුලින්ම ECM බලය/භූගතය බැහැර කර බලන්න: බැටරි වෝල්ටීයතාව 18–32V, ECM භූගතය (J13/J14 සම්බන්ධක, pin 22/24/62/68/81), ECM main relay (X18), ECM fuse (30A slow blow, main 10A) — මේවා හරි නොවේ නම් CAN සන්නිවේදනයක්ම නොවේ.
sets_when: U0167 sets when the ECM does not receive the immobilizer response signal from the ICU
ICU එකෙන් immobilizer ප්‍රතිචාර සංඥාව ECM එකට නොලැබෙන විට U0167 සකස් වේ
liveData.note: If No, the immobilizer is not programmed in the ECM
No නම්, ECM එකේ immobilizer program කර නැත
Shows whether a response signal has arrived from the ICU
ICU එකෙන් ප්‍රතිචාර සංඥාවක් ලැබී ඇත්දැයි පෙන්වයි
If Yes, the ICU is sending a wrong response
Yes නම්, ICU එක වැරදි ප්‍රතිචාරයක් යවයි
If Active, a wait period is running because of a wrong code attempt
Active නම්, වැරදි කේත උත්සාහයක් නිසා රැඳී සිටීමේ කාලයක් ක්‍රියාත්මකයි
location: Immobilizer Control Unit (ICU) ↔ ECM CAN Communication — ICU harness connector B-109, usually mounted near the steering column/ignition switch.
Immobilizer Control Unit (ICU) ↔ ECM CAN සන්නිවේදනය — ICU හාර්නස් සම්බන්ධකය B-109, සාමාන්‍යයෙන් සුක්කානම් කුළුණ/ඉග්නිෂන් ස්විචය අවට සවි කර ඇත.
